# Meno Studio

> AI-first visual website editor

Meno Studio is an AI-powered web builder that turns your ideas into production-ready websites. Describe what you want, refine it visually, and publish—all in one place.

## Features

- AI-First Editing: Built-in AI assistant that understands your project
- Visual Editor: Drag-and-drop page builder with live preview
- Built-in CMS: Custom content collections with typed fields
- Multi Language: Localized content with language-specific URLs
- Git Version Control: Every change is a commit with full audit trail
- Own Your Data: Files stored in your repository, zero vendor lock-in
